result.stdout:
Lakerfield HTTP Server | Serve a folder over HTTP

Usage: http-server [folder] [options]
       http-server            (no arguments: interactive mode)

Options:
  -p, --port <port>         Port to listen on (default: 8080)
  -b, --bind <address>      localhost, all or an IP address (default: localhost)
  -i, --index <file>        Default file name, empty to disable (default: 
index.html)
  -d, --dir                 Enable directory browser
  -a, --auth <user[:pass]>  Require basic auth, prompts for password when 
omitted
  -c, --cors                Allow any origin (CORS)
  -s, --spa                 SPA fallback: unknown routes serve the default file
      --cache               Do not send no-cache headers
  -q, --quiet               Do not log requests
  -h, --help                Show this help

Examples:
  http-server .
  http-server ./dist -p 3000 -s
  http-server C:\share -b all -d -a admin:secret
